answer: The voyage index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1010 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the sonnet. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the reef queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Bonded capital sits idle for 12 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
